title: Long-window check of a balanced-community reversal (alpha_inter=0.6, S=8, phi=0.4, sigma_env=0.5)
purpose: Bounded robustness check that the floor-free reversal R>1 found in the sigma_mechanism grids survives a 6000-step trajectory with 3000 burn-in. Not a search for new reversal cells.
rationale: Prespecified in correspondence discussion 89 before running: success is R>1 with the 95% Monte Carlo lower bound above 1.
500 replicates per scenario were fixed before running.
Floor occupancy is recorded from the production rows; clipping coverage comes from the retained guard diagnostic.
acceptance_checks: The combined parquet validates against the manifest.
Prespecified success: R>1 with 95% MC lower bound above 1.
